title: Hearty Grassy Moroccan Lamb Mechoui
description: A traditional Moroccan dish featuring tender lamb and sweet Bramley apples, all wrapped in a flaky crust, perfect for a lazy Sunday dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the lamb shoulder and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the sliced apples, spices, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Roll out the puff pastry and place it over the top of the Dutch oven.
Crimp the edges of the pastry to seal the pot and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Place the pot in the preheated oven and cook for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the pastry is golden brown.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
